Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 11 Others Counsel for Petitioner :- Sunil Kumar Pandey Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Surendra Singh-I,J.
Heard Sri Sunil Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for the petitioners and Ms. Manju Thakur, learned A.G.A. for the State respondents.

By means of the present petition the petitioner is seeking direction to respondent authorities to ensure fair, impartial and proper investigation of the Case Crime No. 0590 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Handia, District Prayagraj.
Learned counsel has prayed for issuance of suitable direction for fair and impartial investigation.

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. submits that the police authorities are under the obligation to do the investigation fairly, impartially and expeditiously and the same would be done in accordance with law.

The present petition is disposed of directing the police authorities to conclude the investigation of the said case fairly, impartially and expeditiously, preferably within three months from the date of production of a certified copy of this order before them.
It is made clear that this Court has not expressed any opinion on the merits of the case and the competent authority to act in accordance with law.
